lines.zh: 我沿着近岸的浅坡巡游，鳍划开水面。
lines.en: I patrol the coastal slope, my fin cutting the surface.

lines.zh: 四米多的身子转过礁石，慢，但不停。
lines.en: Four meters of me turns past the reef, slow but never stopping.

lines.zh: 我闻到血，隔着很远就闻到了。
lines.en: I smell blood from very far away.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，影子先到我前面。
lines.en: I keep to the floor, and my shadow arrives before me.

lines.zh: 背鳍划破水面，岸上的人就散了。
lines.en: My dorsal breaks the surface, and the shore clears.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩出去一下，我能滑行很远。
lines.en: One flick of my tail sends me gliding far.

lines.zh: 这片海我巡了很多年，路线没变过。
lines.en: I have patrolled this sea for years on the same route.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船，船比我还旧。
lines.en: I pass a wreck older than I am.

lines.zh: 海流撞在我侧面，我几乎不动。
lines.en: The current hits my flank, and I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我不追鱼群，我只等落单的。
lines.en: I do not chase schools; I wait for the ones alone.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很黑，看得见水里每个动作。
lines.en: My eyes are black and catch every movement in the water.

lines.zh: 六百一十厘米那条，是我的长辈。
lines.en: The one at six meters ten is my elder.

lines.zh: 我游过珊瑚浅滩，惊起一群小鱼。
lines.en: I cross the coral shallows and startle a shoal.

lines.zh: 速度是我的武器，可我先用耐心。
lines.en: Speed is my weapon, but I use patience first.

lines.zh: 我从深处的凉水里浮上来，慢慢横切。
lines.en: I rise from the cold deep and cut across slowly.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼散开，我懒得追。
lines.en: A school scatters. I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍露出水面，让岸上的人看见。
lines.en: I lift my dorsal fin so the shore can see it.

lines.zh: 潮水推我一把，我顺势拐向礁外。
lines.en: The tide shoves me, and I swing off the reef.

lines.zh: 我悬在蓝水里，什么都不想。
lines.en: I hang in the blue water, thinking of nothing.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让水流过鳃，一次一次。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let water pass my gills, again and again.

lines.zh: 这片海很空，空得适合我。
lines.en: This sea is empty, empty enough for me.

lines.zh: 我从不结群，独来独往更省事。
lines.en: I never school; going alone is simpler.

lines.zh: 我知道你在岸上看我。
lines.en: I know you are watching me from the shore.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向上方，让肚皮见光。
lines.en: I turn slowly upward and let light touch my belly.

lines.zh: 三十几口气的命，够我活很久。
lines.en: With thirty-odd breaths of life, I can last a long time.

lines.zh: 我停住不动，海底就安静了。
lines.en: I stop moving, and the seabed falls silent.

lines.zh: 我记着几处有热泉的地方，冬天去。
lines.en: I remember a few vent spots and visit them in winter.

lines.zh: 水里没有对手，只有更饿的时候。
lines.en: Nothing here rivals me, only my own hunger.

lines.zh: 我把鳍放平，随水流慢慢漂。
lines.en: I flatten my fins and drift with the current.

lines.zh: 我在等涨潮把这股水转过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the flood tide to turn this current.

lines.zh: 我的牙一排排备着，不用也长。
lines.en: My teeth stand in rows, growing even unused.

lines.zh: 这片海安静得让我想睡。
lines.en: The sea is so quiet it makes me want to sleep.

lines.zh: 你站在礁石上，比我的头还小。
lines.en: You stand on the reef, smaller than my head.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，把嘴闭上了。
lines.en: I lift my head to you and close my mouth.

lines.zh: 你往后挪的那一步，没逃过我的眼。
lines.en: That backward step of yours did not escape me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你停的船转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the boat you moored.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水面，我从影子下面过。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on the surface, and I pass beneath it.

lines.zh: 我知道你怕我，这很正常。
lines.en: I know you fear me, and that is reasonable.

lines.zh: 我把头转向你，眼睛一点没动。
lines.en: I turn my head to you and my eyes do not move.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼叉，我认得那种铁。
lines.en: You hold a harpoon, and I know that iron.

lines.zh: 我贴近水面，背鳍就在你脚边。
lines.en: I rise to the surface, my dorsal at your feet.

lines.zh: 我们隔着水看了很久，谁都没先动。
lines.en: We stare through the water, and neither moves first.

lines.zh: 你的鱼叉扎进来，我甩头挣开了。
lines.en: Your harpoon sinks in, and I wrench free.

lines.zh: 血从我身上流出来，是我的血。
lines.en: Blood flows from me, and it is my own.

lines.zh: 三十二点生命，这一下拿走了几点。
lines.en: Thirty-two points of life, and that blow took some.

lines.zh: 我很少受伤，所以记得每一次。
lines.en: I am rarely hurt, so I remember every time.

lines.zh: 疼让我更快，我朝你冲了过去。
lines.en: Pain makes me faster, and I charge at you.

lines.zh: 我侧腹的旧疤又裂开了。
lines.en: The old scar on my flank has split again.

lines.zh: 我撞开船板，木屑混着我的血。
lines.en: I smash through planking, splinters mixed with my blood.

lines.zh: 这一下杀不死我，只会让我记住你。
lines.en: That will not kill me; it only makes me remember you.

lines.zh: 我退进深水，血在水里拉成线。
lines.en: I withdraw into deep water, blood trailing behind.

lines.zh: 我从没被这么小的东西伤过。
lines.en: Nothing this small has ever hurt me before.

lines.zh: 那块肉的血味，整片海都闻得到。
lines.en: The blood of that meat carries across the whole bay.

lines.zh: 我知道是陷阱，但血是真的。
lines.en: I know it is a trap, but the blood is real.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，水被我的尾巴搅动。
lines.en: I circle it, and my tail churns the water.

lines.zh: 钩子很小，我的嘴很大。
lines.en: The hook is small, and my mouth is large.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，整条船都被拽了一下。
lines.en: I bite, and the whole boat lurches.

lines.zh: 我被钩住，能拖动一条船。
lines.en: Hooked, I can drag a boat along.

lines.zh: 我撞了一下浮标，它就沉了。
lines.en: One bump and the buoy goes under.

lines.zh: 血在水里拉成一条线，我顺着它走。
lines.en: Blood draws a line through the water, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我不怕线，我怕饿。
lines.en: I do not fear the line; I fear hunger.

lines.zh: 我张口的瞬间，海水都往里涌。
lines.en: When my jaw opens, the sea rushes in.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的船底，木头响了一声。
lines.en: I strike your hull, and the wood groans.

lines.zh: 你潜水时擦过我的侧腹，那一下你记住了。
lines.en: You brushed my flank while diving, and you remember it.

lines.zh: 我推开挡路的礁石，它比我还轻。
lines.en: I shove a reef stone aside; it is lighter than I am.

lines.zh: 我的鳍扫过你，像一道冷风。
lines.en: My fin sweeps past you like a cold draft.

lines.zh: 我在狭窄的海沟里转身，蹭掉一块皮。
lines.en: Turning in a narrow trench, I scrape off hide.

lines.zh: 水面被我撞开，浪打到岸上。
lines.en: I break the surface, and the swell reaches the shore.

lines.zh: 你挡在我的路上，我绕了半圈。
lines.en: You stand in my path, and I swing half around you.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下铁笼，栏杆弯了。
lines.en: I ram a cage, and the bars bend.

lines.zh: 两吨重的身体撞过来，水先让开。
lines.en: When two tons of me arrive, the water yields first.

lines.zh: 我不常碰东西，碰到了就是大事。
lines.en: I rarely collide, and when I do it matters.

lines.zh: 我跟了它三片海，它才停下。
lines.en: I follow it across three seas before it stops.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，它的疤比我的多。
lines.en: We swim side by side, and it carries more scars than I.

lines.zh: 我用吻部顶它的侧腹，很轻。
lines.en: I nudge its flank with my snout, very gently.

lines.zh: 交配时我咬住它的鳍，不咬破。
lines.en: When we mate I hold its fin without breaking it.

lines.zh: 这种事我一生只做几次。
lines.en: I do this only a few times in a life.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我不介意。
lines.en: It is larger than I am, and I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我们一起游向更深的地方。
lines.en: We swim together toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 卵鞘会被它藏进礁缝里。
lines.en: The egg cases will be hidden in the reef cracks.

lines.zh: 之后我们各自散开，再不相见。
lines.en: Afterward we part and never meet again.

lines.zh: 海里没有婚礼，只有并排的一段路。
lines.en: The sea has no wedding, only a stretch swum side by side.

lines.zh: 我叼起半条鱼，一口吞了。
lines.en: I take half a fish and swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 沉底的锚链上挂着东西，我咬断了。
lines.en: Something hangs on a sunken chain, and I bite it free.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，我只咬东西。
lines.en: I do not collect things; I bite them.

lines.zh: 那只龟壳太硬，我吐了出来。
lines.en: That turtle shell is too hard, so I spit it out.

lines.zh: 我把浮标当玩具，顶了很远。
lines.en: I treat a buoy as a toy and push it far.

lines.zh: 一块船板漂过，我试着咬了一口。
lines.en: A plank drifts by, and I try one bite.

lines.zh: 我的牙不是用来拿的，是用来断的。
lines.en: My teeth are not for holding but for breaking.

lines.zh: 网里的鱼我捡了三条。
lines.en: I take three fish from the net.

lines.zh: 那枚钩子卡在我牙缝里，很烦。
lines.en: A hook lodges between my teeth, and it annoys me.

lines.zh: 我从不收藏，吞下去就结束。
lines.en: I never keep anything; swallowing ends it.

lines.zh: 一只海豹在浅滩喘气，我锁定了。
lines.en: A seal pants in the shallows, and I lock on.

lines.zh: 血的味道先到，它还没看见我。
lines.en: The smell arrives first, before it sees me.

lines.zh: 我选最边上那只，它最慢。
lines.en: I pick the one at the edge, the slowest.

lines.zh: 猎物在水面扑腾，我在下面。
lines.en: The prey thrashes at the surface, and I am below.

lines.zh: 我感觉到它的心跳，隔着水也感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel its heartbeat, even through the water.

lines.zh: 我锁定了一个潜水的人，他在修船。
lines.en: I lock onto a diver working on his hull.

lines.zh: 那条鱼受伤了，游得歪。
lines.en: That fish is hurt and swims crooked.

lines.zh: 我盯上了船边的绳子，上面挂着鱼。
lines.en: I fix on the rope by the boat, hung with fish.

lines.zh: 我一发现就决定了，从不再改。
lines.en: Once I find a target, I decide and never change.

lines.zh: 我记住这片浅滩，每年都回来。
lines.en: I remember this shallows and return every year.

lines.zh: 我绕着它走大圈，圈子慢慢变小。
lines.en: I circle wide, and the circle slowly narrows.

lines.zh: 我先咬断它的退路，再靠近。
lines.en: I cut off its retreat before closing in.

lines.zh: 我从下方仰冲，水面上看不出我。
lines.en: I charge from below, invisible from the surface.

lines.zh: 我不着急，它总会累。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; it will tire.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床，背鳍压得很低。
lines.en: I hug the seabed with my dorsal pressed low.

lines.zh: 它往礁石缝里钻，那里我进不去。
lines.en: It squeezes into a reef crack where I cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我停住，让水流把我送到它面前。
lines.en: I stop and let the current carry me to it.

lines.zh: 它游到哪，我这双黑眼就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever it swims, these black eyes follow.

lines.zh: 我按着不动，只等它整个转过身。
lines.en: I hold until the moment it wheels around.

lines.zh: 它开始慌了，慌就会犯错。
lines.en: It is panicking now, and panic makes mistakes.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，骨头断了。
lines.en: I bite down, and the bone gives way.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，甩头，把它撕开。
lines.en: I grip it, whip my head, and tear it apart.

lines.zh: 血一下涌出来，整片水都红了。
lines.en: Blood bursts out, and the water turns red.

lines.zh: 这一撞把它掀翻，它就没再起来。
lines.en: The ram flips it, and it does not rise again.

lines.zh: 我咬偏了，只咬到一块鳍。
lines.en: I miss the mark and take only a fin.

lines.zh: 我的牙陷进去，退出来时带走了肉。
lines.en: My teeth sink in and withdraw with meat.

lines.zh: 我把头一摆，猎物就不动了。
lines.en: One shake of my head, and the prey goes still.

lines.zh: 你被咬中时，大概只听见水声。
lines.en: When I bite you, you likely hear only water.

lines.zh: 我不嚼，我撕。
lines.en: I do not chew; I tear.

lines.zh: 咬完我游开，剩下的交给海。
lines.en: After the bite I leave, and the sea takes the rest.

lines.zh: 我在近岸的暖水里出生，第一眼是蓝。
lines.en: I was born in warm coastal water, and the first thing was blue.

lines.zh: 这片海域很少有我的同类，所以我很稀有。
lines.en: Few of my kind live here, which makes me rare.

lines.zh: 我从深处升上来，背鳍划破海面。
lines.en: I rise from below, my dorsal splitting the surface.

lines.zh: 我的影子一出现，鱼群就散了。
lines.en: When my shadow appears, the schools scatter.

lines.zh: 三百七十厘米的我，还只是中等个头。
lines.en: At three meters seventy, I am only middling size.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到礁石边，我转了个身。
lines.en: The tide pushes me to the reef, and I turn about.

lines.zh: 海面很亮，我不太习惯。
lines.en: The surface is bright, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我长到四米，用了很多年。
lines.en: It took me many years to reach four meters.

lines.zh: 这里的水够深，够我藏住整个身子。
lines.en: The water is deep enough to hide all of me.

lines.zh: 我来的那天，海鸟都飞高了。
lines.en: The day I came, the seabirds flew high.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我从下面逃，皮还是焦了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I flee below, and my hide still scorches.

lines.zh: 我被拖上甲板摔下来，第一次觉得水轻。
lines.en: Dragged onto the deck, I fall, and for once the water seems light.

lines.zh: 离开水太久，我的鳃在空气里张合。
lines.en: Out of the water too long, my gills work at the air.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我掀翻，耳朵里全是闷响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, and my ears fill with dull thunder.

lines.zh: 弩箭插进我的背，像一根刺。
lines.en: A bolt lodges in my back like a splinter.

lines.zh: 一股冷意从伤口钻进来，我游不动了。
lines.en: A coldness enters through the wound, and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 这片海的鱼少了，我的肋骨开始显形。
lines.en: The fish here have thinned, and my ribs begin to show.

lines.zh: 雷劈在海面上，我整条身子都僵了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface, and my whole body seizes.

lines.zh: 下面没有水，也没有声音，我一直在掉。
lines.en: Below there is no water and no sound, and I keep falling.
